title: FluxStore
tagline: Base Fluxstore Multi Vendor checkout plus the manager-fluxstore vendor-admin customizations.
overview: FluxStore on Codeberg is the shared Multi Vendor baseline I customize for Kiddo, LogisticHub, and Sheone. The GitHub manager-fluxstore repo holds vendor-admin work on top of that line.
problem: Three client brands needed the same commerce engine without three unrelated forks of checkout.
solution: Keep a baseline FluxStore tree, then layer brand repos and a manager customization.
architecture: Fluxstore Flutter commerce client + optional manager app. Brand repos (flux-kiddo, flex-*) overlay theme and IA.
challenges: Not letting brand forks diverge past the point of merging Fluxstore updates
lessonsLearned: A named baseline repo makes client forks explainable
futureImprovements: A short upgrade checklist shared across Kiddo / LogisticHub / Sheone
results: One baseline plus three brand storefronts instead of undocumented copies
